source.book: Original kid paraphrases. Book 1 is Genesis 1-2. Book 2 is Genesis 6-9. Not a copyrighted Bible translation.
source.copyrightNote: Short original Tigrinya lines and English glosses for young children. Do not paste a published translation.
source.shape: Creation uses a weekday refrain. Sunday is the first day. Friday is the sixth day, when the people are made. Saturday is the seventh-day rest. Tuesday, the third day, has two pages: land and sea, then grass and trees. Noah is one connected paraphrase of Genesis 6-9: evil on the earth, Noah righteous and obedient, the ark, the family, the animals two by two, the shut door and the rain, the water, the raven, the dove, then dry land, then the rainbow promise.
source.orthographyNote: God's name is እግዚኣብሄር with ሄ, the spelling in ትመ15 (YouVersion Bible 2998). Noah is ኖህ. Evil is ክፋእ. Righteous is ፃድቕ, as in Genesis 6:9. The ark is መርከብ. God commanded ኣዘዞ. Shut is ዓፀዎ. They went out ወፁ. The raven is ኳዅ, as in Genesis 8:7 ንኳዅ ሰደዶ. The dove is ርግቢ, sent ሰደዳ, returned ተመለሰት, holding ቘፅሊ ኣውሊዕ. Dry land is ንቑጽ. The bow is ቀስቲ. The promise is ኪዳን, as in Genesis 9 ኪዳነይ. Rain keeps the pack word ዝናብ; ትመ15 writes ዝናም. Trees in Creation follow ኣእዋም. Grass keeps ሳዕሪ. Creation's good stays ጽቡቕ; ትመ15 writes ፅቡቕ.
source.unlockNote: In the Beginning is the free taste. It opens before any School Path unit is finished. Noah's Ark is not free: it uses the ordinary band-1 progress gate (learned the 8th family), the same gate the Amharic band-1 library uses. It does not change the Creation unlock, the School Path unlocks, or the Amharic tracks.
source.artNote: God is not drawn. Each painting shows the thing that page names, in highland Horn light. People wear sand, linen, or sage. The flood stays gentle.

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰንበት ብርሃን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet senbet brhan fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Sunday God made the light.
pages.pictureHint: Highland dawn, gold light breaking over dry ridges, no sun disk yet, no people

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰኑይ ሰማይ ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet senuy semay fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Monday God made the sky.
pages.pictureHint: A vast highland blue sky, a few high clouds, only a thin escarpment

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰሉስ ምድሪን ባሕሪን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet selus midrin bahrin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Tuesday God made the land and the sea.
pages.pictureHint: Ochre highland hills meeting a clear turquoise Red Sea, no people, no boats

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰሉስ ሳዕሪን ኣእዋምን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet selus sarin aawamin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Tuesday God made the grass and the trees.
pages.pictureHint: Short highland grass, a baobab and acacias, plants only

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ረቡዕ ጸሓይን ወርሒን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet rebu tsehayin werhin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Wednesday God made the sun and the moon.
pages.pictureHint: Highland sky with a large warm sun and a large silver moon

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሓሙስ ኣዕዋፍን ዓሳን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet hamus aawafin asan fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Thursday God made the birds and the fish.
pages.pictureHint: Horn birds in a highland sky and large friendly fish in clear sea water

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ዓርቢ ሰብኣይን ሰበይቲን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet arbi sebayin sebeytin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Friday God made a man and a woman.
pages.pictureHint: A man and a woman with deep brown skin, modest long cotton clothes, standing by a baobab

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ቀዳም ዓረፈ። ኩሉ ጽቡቕ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet qedam arefe. Kullu tsbuq.
pages.meaningEn: On Saturday God rested. Everything was good.
pages.pictureHint: Quiet highland evening, the same two people resting under a baobab, a goat lying down, sea still

question.meaningEn: What did God make on Friday?

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ሰብ ኣብ ምድሪ ክፋእ ከም ዝገብር ረኣየ።
pages.latin: Igziabher seb ab mdri kfa' kem zigebr re'aye.
pages.meaningEn: God saw that people were doing evil on the earth.
pages.pictureHint: A few adults with deep brown skin in sand and sage cloth, turned away from each other, unkind but not violent, no Noah, no God

pages.geez: ኖህ ግና ፃድቕ ሰብ ነበረ። ንእግዚኣብሄር ድማ ይስምዖ ነበረ።
pages.latin: Noh gna tsadq seb nebere. Ni-Igziabher dma yism'o nebere.
pages.meaningEn: But Noah was a righteous man. He obeyed God.
pages.pictureHint: Noah alone, deep brown skin, sand linen tunic, calm, looking toward an empty sky, no divine figure

pages.geez: ማይ ብዙሕ ስለ ዝመጽእ፡ እግዚኣብሄር ንኖህ ዓባይ መርከብ ክሰርሕ ኣዘዞ።
pages.latin: May bzux sle zimetsi', Igziabher ni-Noh abay merkeb kiserh azzezo.
pages.meaningEn: Because a lot of water was coming, God commanded Noah to build a big ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah beside timber and the frame of a big wooden ark, a soft cloud on the horizon, empty sky, no God

pages.geez: ኖህን ሰበይቱን ደቁን ነታ መርከብ ሰርሑ።
pages.latin: Nohn sebeytun dequn neta merkeb serhu.
pages.meaningEn: Noah, his wife, and his children built the ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah, his wife, and two children building a wooden ark, sand linen and sage clothes, braided hair, no red, no animals

pages.geez: ድሕሪኡ ኖህን ሰበይቱን ደቁን ናብታ መርከብ ኣተዉ።
pages.latin: Dhr'u Nohn sebeytun dequn nabta merkeb atewu.
pages.meaningEn: After that, Noah, his wife, and his children went into the ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah, his wife, and two children walking into the open door of the wooden ark, no animals

pages.geez: እንስሳታት ከኣ ክልተ ክልተ ምስኦም ኣተዉ።
pages.latin: Insisatat ke'a kilte kilte msom atewu.
pages.meaningEn: And the animals went in with them, two by two.
pages.pictureHint: Clear pairs of lions, giraffes, elephants, and birds walking into the ark, calm, family small in the doorway

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ናይታ መርከብ ማዕጾ ዓፀዎ። ሽዑ ዝናብ መጸ።
pages.latin: Igziabher nayta merkeb ma'tso 'ats'o. Shyu znab metse.
pages.meaningEn: God shut the door of the ark. Then the rain came.
pages.pictureHint: The ark door shut, gentle rain beginning, no hand, no face, no people in distress

pages.geez: ማይ ነታ ምድሪ ሸፈነ። እታ መርከብ ግና ኣብ ልዕሊኡ ሰላም ነበረት።
pages.latin: May neta mdri shefene. Ita merkeb gna ab l'liu selam neberet.
pages.meaningEn: Water covered the land. But the ark was safe on the water.
pages.pictureHint: Calm water over highland hills, the wooden ark floating safely, no storm, no people

pages.geez: ዝናብ ምስ ደው በለ፡ ኖህ ቅድም ንኳዅ ሰደዶ። ኳዅ ግና ኣይተመለሰን።
pages.latin: Znab ms dew bele, Noh qdm n-kwakh sededo. Kwakh gna aytemelesen.
pages.meaningEn: When the rain stopped, Noah first sent the raven. But the raven did not come back.
pages.pictureHint: Noah at the ark window watching a black raven fly away over calm water, no dove, no olive leaf, no rainbow

pages.geez: ድሕሪኡ ንርግቢ ሰደዳ። ርግቢ ቘፅሊ ኣውሊዕ ሒዛ ናብ ኖህ ተመለሰት።
pages.latin: Dhr'u n-rgbi sededa. Rgbi qotsli awli' hiza nab Noh temeleset.
pages.meaningEn: Then he sent the dove. The dove came back to Noah holding an olive leaf.
pages.pictureHint: Clear sky, Noah at the ark window, one dove arriving with a clear olive sprig, no rainbow

pages.geez: ኖህን ስድራቤቱን ናብ ንቑጽ ምድሪ ወፁ።
pages.latin: Nohn sdrabetun nab nquts mdri wetsu.
pages.meaningEn: Noah and his family went out onto dry land.
pages.pictureHint: Noah, his wife, and two children stepping onto dry ochre land from the ark, clear sky, no rainbow

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ቀስቲ ኣብ ሰማይ ኣንበረ። እዚ ኪዳን እዩ።
pages.latin: Igziabher qesti ab semay anbere. Izi kidan iyu.
pages.meaningEn: God set a rainbow in the sky. This is his promise.
pages.pictureHint: The same family on dry land, a soft rainbow across the sky, the ark on the shore, no divine figure

question.meaningEn: What did God set in the sky?
